submission.implementation_notes: Compiled with Plinth 1.67.0.0. Builtin casing needs no flag any more: 1.67 removed the plugin's `datatypes=BuiltinCasing` option (IntersectMBO/plutus#7859) and the default `SumsOfProducts` enables casing on its own, so the source repo's `preview` cabal flag, its PREVIEW CPP define and the PREVIEW-gated `dropList` emission are all deleted and one build now yields one artifact per scenario. Requires protocol version 11 (van Rossem), live on mainnet since 2026-07-18. Inliner budgets: no inliner pragma. Byte-identical cost to the 1.65 sibling. The compiler is cost-neutral from 1.65 to 1.67 on this code: built from one source at plugin-default inliner budgets, 1.65, 1.66 and 1.67 measure within 0.2% of each other. Any difference against the 1.65 sibling therefore comes from inliner budget values and from validator source vintage, not from the compiler. Source: `lib/Fibonacci.hs` in plinth-cape-submissions @ bf320db5115145f8d8da18bb771fe769dbc4346d.
